archetype: The Technical / Premium Admin Dashboard (Vercel & Supabase inspired)

layouts.dashboard: CSS Grid based layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12). Gap-6 for breathing room. Dashboard KPIs use col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3.
layouts.sidebar: Fixed width 256px on desktop, off-canvas drawer on mobile. Background #111827, border-r border-[#374151].
layouts.receipt: Max-width A4 format (approx 210mm / 794px wide), centered, standard print margins. White background exclusively. Use print CSS media queries to hide sidebars and navigation.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8) for cards and containers to allow content to breathe.

components.cards: rounded-xl bg-[#1F2937] border border-[#374151] shadow-sm. Hover: border-[#4B5563] -translate-y-[1px] transition-transform.
components.buttons: rounded-md font-medium. Primary: bg-emerald-500 text-white hover:bg-emerald-600. Secondary: bg-[#1F2937] text-white border border-[#374151] hover:bg-[#374151].
components.inputs: bg-[#111827] border-[#374151] rounded-md text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/50 focus:border-emerald-500.
components.tables: Shadcn based. Header bg-[#1F2937] text-gray-400. Rows border-b border-[#374151].
components.toasts: Sonner with dark theme, background #1F2937, border #374151, text #F9FAFB.
components.ai_assistant: Large textarea filling most of the viewport height (approx 60vh), with subtle glowing border on focus (ring-emerald-500/30) to signify AI capability.
components.modals_and_dropdowns: MUST have solid background (bg-[#1F2937]) and border. NEVER use transparent backgrounds for overlays.

motion.hover: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out or transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in for dashboard cards (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0).
motion.micro_interactions: Active states scale down slightly (scale-95), inputs and buttons show ring on focus.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against #1F2937 meets 4.5:1. Primary accent #10B981 against white text is ~3:1, use font-medium.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (e.g. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like sidebar toggle).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'FUN FARMHOUSE' brand text in the top left of the sidebar, styling it with 'Outfit' font, font-bold, text-xl, tracking-tight. Do not use an image logo unless requested.
Dashboard is dark mode by default. Receipt page must override dark mode and strictly use white background and dark green text/headings for PDF printing.
Use Shadcn UI components but adjust classes to match the specified hex colors (#111827 for bg, #1F2937 for cards/surfaces, #374151 for borders).
Use standard React context or state management. Write components in .js files instead of .tsx.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, e.g., 'data-testid="generate-booking-btn"'.
Slot conflict engine should be logic handled in a utility function, allowing customizable double slots (Morning 10-4, Evening 5-11, Night 1-6).
For the AI Booking Assistant, design a large text area that is easily readable and has a 'Generate Booking' button that stands out.
Ensure the layout is responsive, providing a mobile-friendly drawer sidebar and stackable cards.
Set up manifest.json for PWA installation. Currency is PKR (Rs.).
universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use grid structures with optical alignment.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals or sticky headers; always use bg-[#1F2937] and border.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all', target specific properties like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform' to avoid breaking transform animations.
Use generous spacing: avoid cramped padding. Minimum padding for cards should be p-6.
All components must handle empty states gracefully (e.g. 'No bookings found' with a subtle icon).
Never use generic AI emojis for icons; strictly stick to lucide-react icon library.
